champion.name: Champion
champion.description: Focuses on raw physical power, refining attacks to deal devastating critical strikes.

battle_master.name: Battle Master
battle_master.description: Employs tactical maneuvers and precision superiority dice to command the battlefield.

eldritch_knight.name: Eldritch Knight
eldritch_knight.description: Combines martial prowess with abjuration and evocation magic for versatility.

school_of_evocation.name: School of Evocation
school_of_evocation.description: Master of elemental forces, shaping powerful destructive spells around allies.

school_of_abjuration.name: School of Abjuration
school_of_abjuration.description: Specializes in protective wards, counterspells, and defensive magic.

school_of_divination.name: School of Divination
school_of_divination.description: Glimpses into the future to alter fate, foreseeing outcomes before they happen.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: Enhances agility and stealth, expertly picking locks and using items in the heat of action.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: Master of surprise attacks, disguise, and deadly poisons delivered from the shadows.

arcane_trickster.name: Arcane Trickster
arcane_trickster.description: Enhances rogue stealth with illusion and enchantment spells to deceive foes.

life_domain.name: Life Domain
life_domain.description: Channeler of divine energy focused on restoring health and preserving life.

light_domain.name: Light Domain
light_domain.description: Wields divine fire and radiant blinding light to scorch dark monstrosities.

war_domain.name: War Domain
war_domain.description: A holy warrior champion inspiring martial excellence and guided strikes.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Specialized in combating hordes or giant beasts through specialized combat tactics.

beast_master.name: Beast Master
beast_master.description: Forms a deep bond with a loyal wild beast companion who fights by their side.

gloom_stalker.name: Gloom Stalker
gloom_stalker.description: A dark wilderness ambusher at home in deep shadows and underdark caverns.

oath_of_devotion.name: Oath of Devotion
oath_of_devotion.description: Embodies the ideal of the knight in shining armor, bound by honor and justice.

oath_of_the_ancients.name: Oath of the Ancients
oath_of_the_ancients.description: Fights for light and nature, preserving life, beauty, and ancient growth.

oath_of_vengeance.name: Oath of Vengeance
oath_of_vengeance.description: A ruthless punisher who hunts down transgressors and exacts retribution.

college_of_lore.name: College of Lore
college_of_lore.description: Gathers knowledge and secrets from all fields, weaving cutting words and extra spells.

college_of_valor.name: College of Valor
college_of_valor.description: Sings epic sagas to inspire allies in martial combat while wielding heavy armor.

college_of_glamour.name: College of Glamour
college_of_glamour.description: Channels fey magic to enthrall audiences and command respect with mesmerizing grace.

circle_of_the_land.name: Circle of the Land
circle_of_the_land.description: Preserves ancient nature lore and draws power directly from specific wilderness terrains.

circle_of_the_moon.name: Circle of the Moon
circle_of_the_moon.description: Master of wild shapes, transforming into powerful elemental beasts in combat.

circle_of_stars.name: Circle of Stars
circle_of_stars.description: Harnesses celestial constellations to channel radiant light and cosmic fates.

the_fiend.name: The Fiend
the_fiend.description: Bound to a lower-planar demon or devil, gaining fire magic and dark vitality.

the_great_old_one.name: The Great Old One
the_great_old_one.description: Gains eldritch mind-bending powers from alien entities beyond the stars.

the_archfey.name: The Archfey
the_archfey.description: Wields whimsical and deceptive fey magic to charm, frighten, and teleport.
